 Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the RSSB Teaching Associate Admit Card 2026 on November 12, 2026. Candidates who have successfully registered for the Teaching Associate Direct Recruitment Examination can now access their hall tickets through the official Rajasthan Recruitment Portal at recruitment.rajasthan.gov.in. Applicants must use their login credentials, including their application number and date of birth, to download the admit card.
 The RSSB Teaching Associate examination will commence on November 17, 2026, with Paper I covering General Studies of Rajasthan. Paper II will be conducted from December 7 to December 21, 2026, for different subjects. Through this recruitment drive, the board aims to fill 3,540 vacancies across various subjects. Candidates must download their admit cards and carefully verify all the details mentioned on them before appearing for the examination. Candidates can also check the latest updates on RSSB Teaching Associate Recruitment 2026 , including vacancy details and the recruitment process.

 How to Download RSSB Teaching Associate Admit Card 2026?
 Candidates appearing for the recruitment examination can download their RSSB Teaching Associate Hall Ticket 2026 online through the Rajasthan Recruitment Portal. They should keep their application number and date of birth ready before starting the download process.
 Follow the steps given below to access the admit card:
 Visit the official Rajasthan Recruitment Portal at recruitment.rajasthan.gov.in.
 On the homepage, navigate to the admit card section.
 Look for the link titled Direct Recruitment of Various Contractual Teaching Associate Posts of Raj CES-2026 (RSSB).
 Click on the relevant admit card download link.
 Enter your application number, date of birth and the displayed CAPTCHA code.
 Submit the login details to proceed.
 The RSSB Teaching Associate Admit Card 2026 will appear on the screen.
 Check all the details mentioned on the hall ticket.
 Download the admit card PDF and take a printout for examination purposes.
 Candidates are advised to keep an additional copy of the admit card to avoid last-minute inconvenience.
 Details Mentioned on Rajasthan RSSB Teaching Associate Hall Ticket 2026
 After downloading the RSSB Teaching Associate Admit Card 2026, candidates should carefully verify all the information printed on it. The hall ticket serves as an important identity and examination document and contains details required for entry into the examination centre.
 The following information is generally mentioned on the admit card:
 Candidate's Name
 Roll Number
 Application Number
 Candidate's Photograph and Signature
 Examination Name
 Examination Date
 Examination Shift and Timing
 Reporting Time
 Examination Centre Name
 Examination Centre Address
 Important Examination Day Instructions
 Candidates should ensure that their personal and examination-related information is correct. If they find any discrepancy in their name, photograph, roll number or other details, they should contact the Rajasthan Staff Selection Board through the appropriate official channel before the examination.
